releaseNotes: Notes Pro 0.12.2 combines positioned text blocks and handwriting on the same page
Text mode lets you tap a position and type there while existing ink remains visible
Added Fineliner, ballpoint, pencil, fountain pen, brush pen and felt-tip styles
Expanded Kaleido-friendly pen colors and added independent marker colors
Added fullscreen Notes writing mode with compact active-tool status
Projects can be created directly from Notes and stored in the shared project registry
Existing Notes v2 data is retained; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
